name: Save changes
description: An illustrative Loom scenario, not live traffic.

steps.name: Apply your edit
steps.description: Authoring applies your edit to the working document state.

steps.name: Request a save
steps.description: Document state asks the gateway to persist the changes.

steps.name: Route the save
steps.description: The gateway delegates persistence to the Document service.

steps.name: Save document
steps.description: The service stores the updated document model and waits for the write to complete.

steps.name: Confirm saved state
steps.description: After a successful write, the service requests a save confirmation.

steps.name: Show saved status
steps.description: Notifications tells the editor interface that changes were saved.
